name: @realm/server
//tsconfig.scripts: the live-*-check scripts sit outside tsconfig.json's src-only include; this second project gives them type coverage
//node-pty: pinned to 1.2.0-beta.15: 1.1.0 prebuild ships non-executable spawn-helper
//claude-agent-sdk: direct dep so the tsup-external import resolves from apps/server at runtime. This copy is the one that MATTERS at runtime: the SDK spawns the `claude` binary from its own platform package, and a packaged app resolves that from Contents/Resources/server/node_modules, not from packages/adapters. Keep the floor in step with packages/adapters — the API rejects a model the bundled binary predates (400 'Claude Code X does not support this model'), so the floor is a model-support floor, not just a bugfix one. ^0.3.281 is what claude-opus-5-5 needs; ^0.3.251 was the floor claude-fable-5-1 set.
//vis-network: vendored for the document preview server, exactly like katex: graphify writes a graph.html whose only script tag points at unpkg, and the guide CSP (default-src 'none') blocks it. preview.ts serves this copy same-origin instead.
//xterm-headless: terminals/screen.ts renders a pty's scrollback into the SCREEN an agent reads. Not on the hot path — scrollback.ts keeps a raw tail for exactly that reason — so this parses on demand, per read, for one terminal.
//modelcontextprotocol-sdk: the hub (mcp/hub.ts) is the ONLY code that speaks MCP to third-party servers — direct dep so its client/transport imports resolve from apps/server at runtime, same as claude-agent-sdk above
//tsx: dev-only: runs scripts/live-*-check.ts, which drive the real agent CLIs
